collection.title: Heroes of Faith
collection.description: Twelve lives that shaped the story of Scripture.

characters.name: Noah
characters.verse: Genesis 6:9 — Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation. Noah walked with God.
characters.fact: Noah spent decades building the ark in obedience before a single drop of rain fell.

characters.name: Abraham
characters.verse: Genesis 15:6 — And he believed the LORD, and he counted it to him as righteousness.
characters.fact: Abraham left his homeland not knowing where he was going, trusting God's promise alone.

characters.name: Joseph
characters.verse: Genesis 50:20 — You meant evil against me, but God meant it for good.
characters.fact: Joseph forgave the brothers who sold him into slavery and saved their lives during famine.

characters.name: Moses
characters.verse: Exodus 3:14 — God said to Moses, 'I AM WHO I AM.'
characters.fact: Moses led roughly two million people out of Egypt and received the Law at Mount Sinai.

characters.name: Joshua
characters.verse: Joshua 1:9 — Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, for the LORD your God is with you.
characters.fact: Joshua led Israel into the Promised Land after Moses' death and never wavered in faith.

characters.name: Deborah
characters.verse: Judges 4:4 — Deborah, a prophetess, was judging Israel at that time.
characters.fact: Deborah was the only female judge of Israel and led the nation to victory in battle.

characters.name: David
characters.verse: 1 Samuel 13:14 — The LORD has sought out a man after his own heart.
characters.fact: David went from shepherding sheep to ruling Israel, and wrote many of the Psalms.

characters.name: Isaiah
characters.verse: Isaiah 6:8 — Here am I! Send me.
characters.fact: Isaiah's prophecies about a coming Messiah are quoted throughout the New Testament.

characters.name: Daniel
characters.verse: Daniel 6:23 — No kind of harm was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.
characters.fact: Daniel remained faithful in prayer even under threat of the lions' den.

characters.name: Esther
characters.verse: Esther 4:14 — For such a time as this.
characters.fact: Esther risked her life to save her people, trusting God's providence in a hidden way.

characters.name: Peter
characters.verse: Matthew 16:16 — You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
characters.fact: Peter denied Christ three times, yet was restored and became a founding leader of the church.

characters.name: Paul
characters.verse: Philippians 4:13 — I can do all things through him who strengthens me.
characters.fact: Paul went from persecuting the church to writing much of the New Testament.
